name: agent-instructions-setup
description: AI coding agent instruction file init and retrofit across three modes: solo, project-team, and cross-project knowledge hub. Creates AGENTS.md as the single source of truth, symlinks across major AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Zed, Antigravity, Amp, Aider, Continue), an AI-first agents/ content directory, and a .agents/ meta directory (README, schema, conventions, preset.json, hooks, local) mirroring the .kb/ pattern. Bundles a meta-validator companion skill that auto-fixes frontmatter / relations / git timestamps, rebuilds .agents/.tag-index, scans for secrets, and enforces tight length recommendations (AGENTS.md 50/80/120, agents/*.md 80/100/150). Project-team mode adds onboarding, ADR, RFC, runbook, postmortem, glossary, security, CODEOWNERS. Hub mode builds a cross-project catalog with project registry, tech radar, shared libraries, infrastructure, cross-service incident response, and org-level ADRs. Use whenever the user wants to initialize a project, bootstrap AGENTS.md, unify instruction files across AI tools, retrofit an existing project, set up a team shared knowledge base, create a hub across multiple projects, or evolve agents/ docs - even if they only mention one tool or ask generically about 'AI rules' or 'agent config'.
